name: George Heywood
role: Wounded by Bob Roberts in a Medora saloon
bio: George Heywood was shot in November 1884 by Bob Roberts in Roberts' Medora saloon. Reports said Heywood had come in armed and threatened to kill Roberts, and the wound in his left breast was not fatal and healed well.

moments.label: Wounded in a shooting with Bob Roberts
Reported to have entered the saloon armed

mentions: Last Thursday evening a shooting affray took place between George Heywood and Bob Roberts, Mr. Heywood receiving a painful but not fatal wound. From information gleaned it seems that ill feeling has existed between these two gentlemen for some…
Bob Roberts of Medora, well known in Bismarck, shot but did not kill Geo. Heywood, who, had, it is claimed, threatened to kill him.
Stationery at Cooks.  George Heywood's wound is healing kindly.
